capabilities: Parse notes into cards using head, list, card, title, or file modes
Preview and select parsed cards in a sync panel
Push, update, or delete notes in Anki with status checks
Apply built-in or custom Anki card templates with CSS
Generate backlinks that open the source note from Anki
extras: Chinese documentation is available in README.zh.md; installation is via BRAT or manual release download. Obsidian 1.7.2+ required.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to author flashcards and push them into Anki for spaced-repetition study.

relations.evidence: turns notes into Anki decks via AnkiConnect
Backlink scheme — none / oburi / aduri (Advanced URI)

summary: Flashcard plugin that turns Obsidian notes into Anki decks via AnkiConnect, with five parse modes, card previews, and two-way sync status checks.
